protocol.dataset: balanced AB/BA + same common suffix, disjoint held-out suffix strings (length >0), new edge jitter per pair
protocol.wave: unchanged SliderWaveMemoryV3 eight-node, sixteen-edge Fourier plasticity; 1536 integration steps/write; 1024-step nonwriting probe at 196 Hz, node 6, 128 scalar samples
protocol.comparators: 16-slot sparse-ring recurrence, 8-,16-,32-state untrained random tanh ESNs, 16-slot exponential trace bank and additive bag; outputs from 128 fixed time-varying scalar measurements of frozen state; neither classifier nor output observes state vector directly
protocol.sensor_caveat: Static cosine bank is an idealized, potentially better conditioned transducer than the wave graph probe; it is not identical physical readout hardware. Both are restricted to 128 scalar nonwriting readings.
protocol.training: same fixed ridge method/regularization, same cases and labels for all models; no hyperparameter tuning on test
protocol.noise: Gaussian noise with SD as fraction of each model clean training-read RMS; same noise seeds, separate train and test draws; no retraining on noisy test
protocol.comparison_scope: 16 mutable scalar memory slots matched, not fixed model parameter count, actual hardware physics, FLOP budget or energy
protocol.work_count: lower-bound per-sample dense MAC proxy; ignores transcendental functions, exposure updates, JIT speed and latency
